entities.summary: Lucius Gellius was a Roman politician and general who was one of two consuls of the Republic in 72 BC, along with Gnaeus Cornelius Lentulus Clodianus. A supporter of Pompey, he is noted for being one of the consular generals who led Roman legions against the slave armies of Spartacus in the Third Servile War.
